description: This Java class defines an abstract comparison node used in an abstract syntax tree for representing comparison operations within a query language or expression framework. It models a generic comparison with a type, property, and value, intended to be extended for specific comparison types.

classes.name: ComparisonNode
classes.description: An abstract generic class representing a comparison operation node in an abstract syntax tree, parameterized by comparison type enum and comparison value type.

methods.name: ComparisonNode
methods.description: Constructor initializing the comparison node with type, property, and value.

methods.name: getComparisonType
methods.description: Returns the type of comparison (e.g., EQ, NEQ).

methods.name: getComparisonProperty
methods.description: Returns the property name to compare on.

methods.name: getComparisonValue
methods.description: Returns the value to compare against.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Implements the visitor pattern by accepting a PredicateVisitor.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the comparison node.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on property, type, and value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on property, type, and value.
